text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report outlines the results of an investigation into installing speed humps on Arrowsmith Avenue, between Keele Street and Amesbury Drive. The results indicate that the criteria to justify installing speed humps are not satisfied.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Arrowsmith Avenue, between Keele Street and Amesbury Drive. 2. Authorized the Director, Transportation Services to request the City Clerk to poll eligible householders in English or any other language specified by Community Council, on Arrowsmith Avenue, between Keele Street and Amesbury Drive, to determine if property owners/occupants support the installation, according to the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy. 3. Subject to favourable results of the poll: a. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Arrowsmith Avenue, between Keele Street and Amesbury Drive. b.
